business_problem: Mid-Ohio Food Collective had limited engineering capacity to improve FreshTrak and adapt it to each food bank's state-specific eligibility, reporting, and consent rules, slowing feature delivery and expansion to more food banks.
solution_summary: Mid-Ohio Food Collective uses Claude to accelerate development and expansion of FreshTrak, its food-bank platform. Given the existing codebase and a new state's rules, Claude Code produced a working, tested implementation; engineers and program staff validate each rule, and Claude Tag works through the codebase from Slack to open a pull request. Human approval, automated tests, and Claude-assisted review precede the CI/CD pipeline. Claude Code supports larger refactors and multi-service changes in a codebase more than 15 years old, while Claude Design combines Figma designs with interview requirements to create a shared UI system. The team also used Claude to build mobile-app flows and APIs and integrate FreshTrak Health referrals from partner health systems, record Farmacy visits, and send outcomes to care teams. The story does not detail hosting or storage.

data_flow: A developer or support teammate briefs Claude Tag in Slack; it examines the FreshTrak codebase and opens a pull request. A human engineer reviews the change, automated tests run, and Claude-assisted review occurs before CI/CD. Separately, partner health-system referrals linked to electronic health records enter FreshTrak Health, where visits are recorded and outcomes are sent back to care teams.
integration_points: Partner health systems and their electronic health records
business_outcome: Claude helped the Food Collective deliver software features faster, reduce the manual effort needed to adapt FreshTrak for other states and food banks, and bring product ideas into production that the team previously lacked capacity to pursue.
metrics: Ships new features from idea to production in 24 to 36 hours, down from two to three months
FreshTrak runs at some 2,500 pantries, soup kitchens, shelters and food banks
More than 12.5 million household visits a year
Cut onboarding and training time for partner food banks by 50%
A technical support team member's first pull request went to production in under 12 hours
FreshTrak has logged 68 million visits since launch
